properties.name: Willett School Tiot Trail leg
properties.section_description: Planned 0.37-mile Tiot Trail leg behind Willett School, from the easement to Westover Parkway. Red follows the brochure. Approximate alignment registered to the mapped school building footprint using the supplied satellite crop.
properties.alignment_method: Red pixel mask thinned to a connected centerline; every one-pixel centerline vertex retained (1274 vertices). Four-school-corner image registration retained. No route smoothing.
